subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier emails about optimizing {Brand} to the retained D7 user. One timely reason it matters now: Apple's WWDC 2025 AdAttributionKit update, live in iOS 18.4, allows overlapping re-engagement windows, so the day-seven return a builder economy lives on reads as its own signal instead of folded into the install. Against a US iOS CPI band near $3.00 for casual and $3.75 for simulation, that read decides your real payback. Family Island is buying US volume hard into this setup. Want to compare it with your source mix?
angle: fresh angle: AdAttributionKit iOS 18.4 re-engagement windows (WWDC 2025, sourced) + US iOS casual/sim CPI band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN gaming_casual: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior outreach; fresh angle = timely sourced development (AdAttributionKit iOS 18.4 overlapping re-engagement windows, WWDC 2025) plus REAL web-verified US iOS CPI band (casual ~$3.00, simulation ~$3.75, FoxData retrieved); one named peer from brand_candidates (Family Island); no MobUpps figure this stage; exactly 1 question mark; native US register; no sign-off; no 'X, not Y'.
